body:
[A571] REVIEW READY

Head: `69a312e3914f96c2db5fa51f07b087a6cd6ff349` on `requirements-port`.

Two one-line commits add the independent ADP advertisement vector and eleven field defects, then port 24 requirements with origins, linked clauses and verification methods. The inventory accounts for all 114 numbered source rows and both Mark II decisions. Port obligations and exclusions include their reasons. Traceability and test inventories are regenerated.

Both steps passed every non-privacy gate. Hosted compiler tests, sanitizers, static analysis and 100% coverage pass. All 322 mutation plants and report controls pass. All three graphs render. Freestanding RV32 Debug and Release link and execute their smoke checks. Production sources and headers are unchanged.

The only failing gate is `privacy`, on base commit `18d737832c376f32660eb21fe2796e0b611507e3`'s stored identity. Both new commit identities pass. The [manager ruling](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/issues/14#issuecomment-6081168071) authorizes delivery with this failure recorded. [PR 17](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/pull/17) supplies the fix; the manager merges main before review. The gate, identity configuration and history are unchanged.

HANDOFF.md and PR-BODY.md are updated with mapping, defects, both-target gate results and evidence hashes. The PR body says `Relates to #14`. Deployment timing, durable storage and complete recovery accounting remain explicit port obligations on both targets. Worktree clean. No push or PR creation. All campaigns have exited.
